messages:
alex: Heads-up — after today's Calico 3.25 rollout to prod-gpu, we're seeing intermittent packet loss between GPU pods in the eu-west cluster. A couple of nightly training jobs failed with checkpoint push timeouts.
jessie: ugh. any pattern (node/AZ/network path)?
alex: Seems east-west only on the dedicated GPU nodepool (tainted). Pod -> pod on different nodes shows ~2-5% packet loss at the app layer, same node is fine. cpu/mem look normal.
mike: did you check MTU and tunnel mode? Calico defaults changed to geneve in the new image iirc.
alex: yep. host MTU is 9000, calico_tunnel_mtu is 1400 in the daemonset config we rolled. suspect mismatch when host uses GSO/TSO with large frames through NIC.
cheng: can you paste ip link and calico config?
alex: sure:
```
# on gpu-node-12
ip link show eth0
3: eth0: mtu 9000 qdisc mq state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000\n    link/ether aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff

# calico config map snippet
dataplane: "calico"
calico_backend: "bird"
tunnel_mode: "geneve"
calico_vxlan_mtu: "1400"
```

jessie: if host mtu 9000 and geneve mtu 1400 that seems odd — shouldn't the tunnel mtu be set so that inner packet fits? maybe fragmentation + GSO issues.
mike: also check offload flags: ethtool -k eth0 | grep gso
alex: running that now...
```
ethtool -k eth0 | grep gso
large-gso: on
gso: on
tcp-gso: on
```

alex: iperf3 between pods on different nodes shows 10-20% retransmits. tcpdump shows occasional 1514B fragments instead of 9000.
cheng: could be Calico doing encapsulation and not negotiating proper GSO/TSO offload for geneve. There's a known kernel issue where geneve+gso requires offloads to be disabled or patched.
jessie: rollback option? We need GPU jobs to finish.
mike: two options: revert calico to 3.24, or change tunnel_mode to ipip (or disable encapsulation if we can use BGP direct). Reverting might be faster.
alex: I opened a rollback DC on the canary nodes but prod-gpu was targeted in the rollout job. infra-bot said rollout completed at 1784123300.
infra-bot: Deploy bot: calico/daemonset v3.25 rolled to prod-gpu pool at 1784123300. No immediate alerts detected by monitors.
jen: (added from SRE) is there an easy per-node workaround?
cheng: you can set `ip link set dev <genev_iface> gro off gso off tso off` to test if offloads are causing the problem. That will hurt throughput but confirm root cause.
alex: did that on gpu-node-12: turned gro/gso off on cali+geneve iface and packet loss dropped to <0.1% and jobs resumed pushing checkpoints. So offload is the trigger.
jessie: good repro. We should patch daemonset to set `operatingMode` or set `DisableGRO: true`? Not sure calico supports that directly.
mike: Calico doesn't toggle host offloads for you. Short term: add a node-local initContainer to disable offloads on GPU nodes, or taint + drain and revert the DS. Long term: upstream kernel/Calico fix or set tunnel_mtu to 8950-ish so GSO segmentation doesn't break.
alex: opened issue: https://github.com/projectcalico/calico/issues/XXXXX with logs and iperf pcap.
cheng: also check RDMA paths — NVMe over fabrics and GPUDirect RDMA can break if kernel splinters packets. Are any jobs using ibverbs?
alex: two training jobs use RDMA for NCCL across nodes. After disabling offloads they recovered. So RDMA was impacted.
jessie: action items: 1) rollback 3.25 on prod-gpu (short term) 2) add node init hack to disable offloads on GPU pool (mitigation) 3) open support ticket with Calico + provide pcap and tcpdump (done) 4) test alternative tunnel modes / MTU combos on staging (mike/cheng) 5) follow-up PR to update runbook with steps to quickly revert or disable offloads.
mike: I'll start a rollback PR for the kustomize overlay and target 3.24 patch. Will also coordinate a scheduled maintenance window if needed.
alex: thanks. tagging @jessie to keep product teams updated about potential delay on scheduled nightly training.
jessie: thanks. I'll message the ML infra channel and pause new runs for 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1142 - Calico 3.25 geneve offload regression impacting GPU pod east-west networking. Priority: P2.
alex: keeping thread updated with results from rollback test.
